title: Why Do We Dream?
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์
lines: Everyone dreams, even people who say they never do. Scientists believe
we have between four and six dreams every night, but we forget most of
**them** within minutes of waking up. Dreams happen mainly during a stage
of sleep called REM, when the eyes move quickly behind closed lids.
Why we dream is still a mystery. One popular theory is that dreams help
the brain sort and store memories from the day. In experiments, people
who slept after learning a new task performed better than **those** who
stayed awake. Another theory suggests that dreams let us practice how to
react to danger in a safe place. **This** might explain why so many dreams
Not all scientists agree. **Some** argue that dreams have no purpose at all
and are simply random activity in a sleeping brain. Whatever the answer,
most experts agree on one thing: getting enough REM sleep is important.
People who lack **it** often have trouble concentrating and remembering.
